dimensions.assessment: Directly affects members and veterans using Selected Reserve education benefits, as well as public colleges and universities.
dimensions.evidence: individuals utilizing the Montgomery GI Bill-Selected Reserve education benefits while living in the state where the education is located

dimensions.assessment: Provides substantial financial relief on tuition costs for eligible reservists attending out-of-state public institutions.
dimensions.evidence: does not charge the in-State tuition rate to a veteran using certain educational assistance

dimensions.assessment: Affects tuition structures and institutional eligibility for GI Bill funds, but does not provide specific federal appropriation figures.
Amends title 38 and title 10 of the United States Code to expand existing tuition fairness rules to an additional category of military educational benefits.
dimensions.evidence: Amends title 38, United States Code, to direct the Secretary of Veterans Affairs to disapprove courses...

dimensions.assessment: Establishes a permanent policy starting with academic periods on or after August 1, 2026, across the nation.
dimensions.evidence: shall apply with respect to an academic period that begins on or after August 1, 2026.

missing_information: Estimated number of reservists who will benefit from in-state tuition rates
Projected changes in federal outlays for veterans' educational assistance
importance_detail.rationale: The act requires the Department of Veterans Affairs to disapprove courses at public institutions of higher learning that charge out-of-state tuition to individuals using Montgomery GI Bill-Selected Reserve benefits while living in that state.
